description: Read one currently visible listing and its dated evidence. Optional assessment_history contains ten actual completed and applied Directory observations or retained linter scans, with source and actual rules version (unknown if absent). Completed and applied unassessed attempts have null grade/score and a fixed reason; they are never F or the shown grade. Profile HTML groups consecutive same-reason unassessed attempts while API rows retain every attempt. Up to 52 Directory observations and 100 linter scans are retained. Supply the returned history_cursor for ten more raw history rows; continuation returns listing_id and assessment_history only. Cursors expire after one hour or a history change; current identity, hiding, canonical, grade and health masks are rechecked on every page. Hidden or ineligible listings return 404; stale history cursors return 410; invalid artifacts fail 503. No job discovery, new probes, grade change or paid delivery certification. Public directory reads share 30 requests per client IP per UTC minute. Search returns at most 100 services per call; a 963-service snapshot needs 10 calls at limit=100. Follow returned cursors and avoid concurrent bursts; 429 means wait for the next UTC minute. No quota increase is implied. Never signs payments.

history_cursor.description: Opaque returned assessment_history.next_cursor. Never fabricate or alter it.

listing_id.description: Visible listing identity, its unique 16-character public reference, or exact service host including an optional port. Hidden, unknown and ambiguous references return 404.

name: retrieve_listing
